summary:
Revised implementation plan for:
- Standard asset override objects ({ imageUri?: string, sheetIndex?: number }) with placeholders across all items, weapons, enemies, and tiles
- Dynamic renderer integration prioritizing entry.assets.imageUri over legacy sheet slices or procedural fallbacks
- 5-tier hierarchical map architecture (world > region > area > local > room)
- Moving initial spawn coordinates into map definitions
- Deleting temporary database/areas bridge folder
